data.name: Technical Program Manager II - FD&E
data.jobDescription:
Overview

Are you passionate about AI, data, and transformative user experiences? Do you bring energy, curiosity, and ownership to your work?   

The Finance Data & Experiences (FD&E) organization is on a mission to redefine how Microsoft measures, monitors, and optimizes its global business — and we’re looking for top talent to join us. This is a unique opportunity to lead with bold ideas, apply cutting-edge technology, and work across Finance, Sales, Marketing, Business Operations, and Product Engineering to deliver high-impact business solutions. The right candidate will thrive in fast-paced, cross-functional environments, bring fresh thinking to complex problems, and be eager to learn to take ownership of end-to-end processes and outcomes. Join us and be part of a team that’s pushing the boundaries of innovation, taking risks, and implementing AI to drive business excellence    

At FD&E, we foster a culture of customer centricity, innovation, agility, and transparency — and we’re building a team that’s ready to help Microsoft chart its next chapter in AI-driven business excellence.   

In this role, you will play a critical role in driving the evolution of the Finance Data platform, which serves as the backbone for numerous downstream solutions and enables standardized, scalable data consumption across Microsoft Finance organizations.
